title: Compliance Evidence for AI Calling (TRAI and DPDP)
summary: Test and document how your AI calling handles consent, DND preferences, calling hours, disclosures, opt-outs and personal data, and give compliance teams and clients an evidence pack.

seo.title: TRAI and DPDP Compliance Evidence for AI Calling | VipraTech
seo.description: Control matrix, test calls and log reconciliation that evidence how AI calling handles consent, DND, disclosures, opt-outs and personal data.

designed_for: BPO Client Audit and Risk Lead

problem.intro: When an operator, BPO or enterprise starts placing calls with an AI agent, the questions from compliance teams, clients and auditors change from whether it works to proof of how it behaves. Did it call only consented numbers within permitted hours, did it disclose that it is automated, did opt-outs take effect, and where do recordings and transcripts go afterwards?

pain_points.title: Controls exist only on paper
pain_points.detail: Policies say numbers are scrubbed and opt-outs honoured, but there is no test evidence that the live system does it.

pain_points.title: Logs are scattered
pain_points.detail: Dialler records, DLT reports, consent systems, CRM and the voice platform each hold part of the story.

pain_points.title: Every BPO client audits differently
pain_points.detail: Each client sends its own questionnaire, and teams rebuild the same evidence by hand for each one.

pain_points.title: Rules and behaviour both change
pain_points.detail: Regulations are amended and the agent changes with every model, prompt or campaign update, so one-off evidence goes stale.

solution.overview: We build an evidence workflow that tests and documents your AI calling against the obligations that apply to you. First we map requirements from TRAI commercial-communication rules, the DPDP Act 2023, client contracts and your own policies into a control matrix that your compliance team approves. Then each control is tested two ways: scripted test calls that probe behaviour, such as disclosure, opt-out and calls attempted outside permitted hours or to suppressed numbers, and log reconciliation that compares calls actually placed with consent records, preference data and suppression lists. Each control gets a PASS, RISK or FAIL result with evidence attached, and a monitoring job re-runs the checks on a schedule.
capabilities: Control matrix built from TRAI commercial-communication rules, the DPDP Act 2023, client contracts and internal policy
Scripted test calls for disclosure, opt-out, consent capture and out-of-scope handling
Reconciliation of call logs against consent records, preference data and suppression lists
Review of recording, transcript and retention settings against stated purpose and policy
PASS, RISK and FAIL results per control with call audio, logs and screenshots as evidence
Scheduled re-checks after model, prompt or campaign changes, with drift alerts

workflow.title: Map obligations
workflow.detail: TRAI rules, DPDP obligations, client clauses and internal policies are mapped to a control matrix.

workflow.title: Approve the matrix
workflow.detail: Your compliance team or DPO approves the controls and the evidence each one needs.

workflow.title: Test behaviour and logs
workflow.detail: Scripted test calls probe agent behaviour while log reconciliation checks the calls actually placed.

workflow.title: Review gaps
workflow.detail: Every RISK or FAIL result goes to the compliance officer, who decides remediation or acceptance.

workflow.title: Assemble the evidence pack
workflow.detail: Results, audio, logs and screenshots are organised by control for internal and client review.

workflow.title: Re-check on schedule
workflow.detail: Checks re-run after changes and at agreed intervals, with drift reported.

inputs: Call detail records and dialler logs
Consent records and preference or scrubbing data
Voice agent scripts, prompts and configuration
Recording and retention settings and privacy notices
outputs: Control matrix with status per control
human_in_the_loop: Your compliance officer or DPO approves the control matrix, reviews every RISK and FAIL result and decides remediation or acceptance. Legal interpretation of the rules stays with your compliance and legal advisers; we provide technical tests and evidence.
integrations: GRC tool or SharePoint for evidence storage
guardrails: Test calls placed only to designated test numbers
Evidence pack access restricted to named reviewers
Each control records which version of the rules it was mapped to
No legal opinions in the evidence pack
compliance_notes: Designed to help you evidence alignment with TRAI's commercial-communication rules and the DPDP Act 2023; it is not a legal opinion or a certification.
Where BPO clients are regulated entities such as banks or NBFCs, their regulator's outsourcing and conduct expectations can be added to the control matrix.

pilot.scope: One AI calling flow, such as a single outbound campaign or inbound service line, with an approved control matrix, test calls and one month of logs.
deliverables: Approved control matrix for the pilot flow
Evidence pack in your preferred format

what_we_measure.how: Controls with attached evidence compared with the controls in the approved matrix.
Log reconciliation exceptions confirmed by the compliance team.
Feedback from compliance reviewers or a client auditor on whether the pack answers their questions.
Time to answer a client audit questionnaire using the pack, compared with the last audit.

faqs.q: Is this a legal opinion on our compliance?
faqs.a: No. We provide technical tests and evidence against a control matrix your compliance or legal team approves. Interpretation of the rules and the final compliance position stay with them.

faqs.q: Do you need access to production logs?
faqs.a: For log reconciliation, yes, but pseudonymised extracts are enough: hashed numbers, timestamps, campaign IDs and outcomes. Test calls are made only to test numbers.

faqs.q: Can the controls cover our BPO clients' own requirements?
faqs.a: Yes. Client contract clauses and sector rules, such as a bank client's expectations on calling conduct, are added to the matrix so one set of evidence can answer several client audits.
On a schedule you choose and after any change to the model, prompt, script or campaign set-up. Each run is versioned, so you can show auditors the history.
